Standard: Covert anti-collision lighting conforms to SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for the Anti- Collision Covert Light paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Test installed covert anti-collision lights for conformance to SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for the Anti-Collision Covert Light paragraph.
